_comment: Padding and margin controls that are NOT a block's own Spacing panel, or that wait for a later stage. check-spacing-panel.js reads this. Keys: files (a whole file), attributes (file::attribute written), blocks (a block that owns padding/margin object attributes but is edited elsewhere). Every entry carries its reason.

files.src/components/button-kit/BuiltinButtonP: The button kit's own Padding (the printed button's padding, prefix-keyed), not a block's spacing.
files.src/blocks/extensions/commerce-look/cont: Commerce-look extension panels: per-part look padding (prefix + 'Padding'), not a block's spacing.
files.src/blocks/extensions/commerce-look/pane: Commerce-look extension panels: per-part look padding, not a block's spacing.

attributes.src/blocks/card-grid/components/CardStyl: Card padding inside the 'Card' panel: the card-grid keeps 'Card spacing' (brief item 3). The block's own padding/margin move to the shared panel.
attributes.src/blocks/container/components/GridItem: Default padding for the container's grid items, not the container's own spacing.
attributes.src/blocks/form-field-textarea/edit.js::: Writes inputPadding (the typed-in box), not padding: the shared panel reads padding/margin. Needs Bean's call (LISTS item 3).
attributes.src/blocks/form-review/edit.js::editButt: The review's edit button padding, not the block's spacing.
attributes.src/blocks/mega-aside/edit.js::asidePadd: The aside column's padding inside the 'Aside' panel, not the block's spacing.

blocks.media: Its padding is the media-padding atom of the media panels (components/media/atoms/media-padding.js), not a Spacing pair.
